title: U.S. Naval Update Map: Nov. 5, 2026
text:
U.S. Naval Update Map: Nov. 5, 2026 | RANE Worldview 
 Collapse Home Regions Themes Analysis Bookmarks Events and Media Sign In (RANE) The Naval Update Map shows the approximate current locations of U.S. Carrier Strike Groups (CSGs) and Amphibious Ready Groups (ARGs), based on available open-source information. No classified or operationally sensitive information is included in this weekly update. CSGs and ARGs are the keys to U.S. dominance over the world's oceans. A CSG is centered on an aircraft carrier and includes significant offensive strike capability. An ARG is centered on three amphibious warfare ships, with a Marine Expeditionary Unit embarked. Carrier Strike Groups CVN 68: The USS Nimitz is underway in the Atlantic Ocean. CVN 69: The USS Dwight D. Eisenhower is underway in the Atlantic Ocean. CVN 71: The USS Theodore Roosevelt is underway in the South China Sea. CVN 73: The USS George Washington is underway in the Arabian Sea. CVN 77: The USS George H.W. Bush is underway in the Arabian Sea.
